method: Rendered PNGs inspected individually; final PDF font and collision audits retained for every figure.
alignment: Nine independent single-axis figures; multi-panel alignment is not applicable and recorded by the audit tool.
source_warnings_reviewed: PNG is a 300 dpi report preview. Editable PDF and SVG are authoritative vector exports; no journal submission TIFF was requested.
The 600 dpi raster default is unnecessary for vector line-art delivery accompanied by a 300 dpi preview.
notes: F1 uses a common effect axis to compare all original baselines; small controller differences are resolved numerically in the paired-effect tables and in F3 for the separate P5 cohort.
F3 explicitly distinguishes fixed w5/B2 from validation-selected w5/B1, and shows both single-control baselines.
F5 includes all five task-count levels and all four light methods with the same hierarchical 95% interval definition.
F7 uses a linear numerical gap axis and all 200 earlier local certificates; no global-optimum interpretation.
F8 is descriptive, with different outcome denominators explicitly identified. Near-coincident light-method points are not jittered; complete numeric data and distinct markers remain available.
All inferential forests show predefined comparisons, including intervals crossing zero; none selected by observed sign.
